root_cause: Repair governance fingerprints the raw Quality Target file but has no baseline-bound representation that separates its required numeric current-round counter from authoritative Target content.
causal_chain: Quality Loop records a failed result and requires the Target 当前轮次 to advance.
The raw Target digest changes even though its goal, scope, acceptance and maximum round remain identical.
compute_diff_review sees the Target outside the ChangePermit and emits out_of_scope_change.
The candidate cannot obtain a PASS diff review even after the actual product defect is repaired.
rejected_hypotheses: Allowing governance/targets/** in product scope is safe; it would grant authority over the Target itself.
Ignoring the entire Target path is safe; it would hide scope or acceptance weakening.
Resetting or editing .quality state is a valid retry; it would rewrite durable evidence.
